data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How do you play five finger fillet? ASSISTANT:

Five Finger Fillet is a game played with two players. The goal is to be the first to get all five fingers of the player's hand on the table. The player with the most fingers on the table when time runs out is the winner.
